title: InputAnswerScope
description: The scope of input.answer (docs/design/m0/04 "Owed inputs" [PR5-1]): the owed input, the revision the answer binds, and the typed answer. The approval's answers list is derived from it. Only an operator or the owed input's owner answers (failed/action_not_granted). An owed input of kind receipt is refused as an invalid scope: only an applicable receipt satisfies it. Otherwise it is refused unless unanswered and at exactly that revision (failed/stale_expected_state).

answer.description: The answer, typed by the owed input's kind.
